title: Man Runs From Police After They Discover His Active Felony Warrant
description:
Use code “BLUE10” for 10% off at checkout!

On May 7, 2022, police responded to a suspicious activity call at a cemetery in La Crosse, WI. When officers made contact with the male, he appeared to be very irritated and argumentative. They eventually discovered he had an active felony warrant and attempted to place him under arrest but he ultimately decided to flee from the officers. 

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
